# Justin Edit — Visual and Audio Style Guide

## Footage and transitions

The presenter’s picture and dialogue from `Camera-Recording.mp4` lead the video. Waterfall footage from `IMG_0133.MOV` and ocean footage from `IMG_0261.MOV` provide video-only cutaways over the continuing presenter dialogue; omit both clips’ source audio. The waterfall cutaway lasts approximately five seconds and opens with a brief dip to white. The ocean footage has smooth, stabilized motion.

## Presenter framing

A selected talking-head segment uses a modest punch-in for a tighter view of the presenter. Keep the remaining presenter segments at their standard framing.

## Opening lower-third

The opening name graphic reads **JUSTIN BROWN** in white uppercase **Oswald Bold**. Place it horizontally centered in the lower third of the presenter image. A solid, fully opaque bright blue rectangle closely surrounds the lettering, with a small visible margin around the letters. Keep the name visible beyond the first five seconds.

## Camera color

Use a warm, bright camera treatment with enhanced contrast and vibrant saturation. Keep this appearance consistent across the edited presenter shots while retaining each segment’s individual framing.

## Audio

Keep the presenter’s speech clear and prominent. `ES_San Pedro - Sugoi.mp3` provides quiet background music from the opening picture to the end of the video. Maintain dialogue and music as separate audio elements, with the presenter clips identified as **Dialogue** and the background track as **Music**.

# Justin Edit — Visual and Audio Style Guide

## Footage and transitions

The presenter’s picture and dialogue from `Camera-Recording.mp4` lead the video. Waterfall footage from `IMG_0133.MOV` and ocean footage from `IMG_0261.MOV` provide video-only cutaways over the continuing presenter dialogue; omit both clips’ source audio. The waterfall cutaway lasts approximately five seconds and opens with a brief dip to white. The ocean footage has smooth, stabilized motion.

## Presenter framing

A selected talking-head segment uses a modest punch-in for a tighter view of the presenter. Keep the remaining presenter segments at their standard framing.

## Opening lower-third

The opening name graphic reads **JUSTIN BROWN** in white uppercase **Oswald Bold**. Place it horizontally centered in the lower third of the presenter image. A solid, fully opaque bright blue rectangle closely surrounds the lettering, with a small visible margin around the letters. Keep the name visible beyond the first five seconds.

## Camera color

Use a warm, bright camera treatment with enhanced contrast and vibrant saturation. Keep this appearance consistent across the edited presenter shots while retaining each segment’s individual framing.

## Audio

Keep the presenter’s speech clear and prominent. `ES_San Pedro - Sugoi.mp3` provides quiet background music from the opening picture to the end of the video. Maintain dialogue and music as separate audio elements, with the presenter clips identified as **Dialogue** and the background track as **Music**.

title: Volume
version: 2

parameters:
  - identifier: argument (*deprecated*)
    title: Gain
    type: string
    description: |
                 The gain may be indicated as a floating point value of the gain adjustment.
                 The gain may also be indicated as a numeric value with the suffix "dB" to adjust in terms of decibels.
                 The gain may also be set to "normalise" to normalise the volume to the target amplitude -12dBFS.
                 This value is discarded if value for property "level" is set.
  - identifier: window
    title: Window
    type: integer
    description: The number of video frames over which to smooth normalisation.
    default: 75
    mutable: yes
  - identifier: normalise
    title: Normalise
    type: string
    description: |
                 Normalise the volume to the specified amplitude.
                 The normalization may be indicated as a floating point value of the relative volume.
                 The normalisation may also be indicated as a numeric value with the suffix "dB" to set the amplitude in decibels.
    default: -12dBFS
    mutable: yes
  - identifier: limiter
    title: Limiter
    type: string
    description: |
                 Limit all samples above the specified amplitude.
                 The limiting may be indicated as a floating point value of the relative volume.
                 The limiting may also be indicated as a numeric value with the suffix "dB" to set the limiting amplitude in decibels.
    default: -6dBFS
    mutable: yes
  - identifier: max_gain
    title: Max gain
    type: string
    description: A floating point or decibel value of the maximum gain that can be applied during normalisation.
    default: 20dB
    mutable: yes
  - identifier: end (*deprecated*)
    title: End gain
    type: string
    description: |

    type: float
    description: 'The animated value of the gain adjustment in dB. Properties "gain" and "end" are ignored if this is set.'
    unit: dB
    mutable: yes

---
schema_version: 0.1
type: filter
identifier: lift_gamma_gain
title: Lift, Gamma, and Gain
version: 1
copyright: Meltytech, LLC
license: LGPLv2.1
language: en
tags:
  - Video
description: A simple lift/gamma/gain effect, used for color grading.
notes: "Very roughly speaking, lift=shadows, gamma=midtones and gain=highlights, although all parameters affect the entire curve. Mathematically speaking, it is a bit unusual to look at gamma as a color, but it works pretty well in practice. The classic formula is: output = (gain * (x + lift * (1-x)))^(1/gamma). The lift is a case where we actually would _not_ want linear light; since black by definition becomes equal to the lift color, we want lift to be pretty close to black, but in linear light that means lift affects the rest of the curve relatively little. Thus, we actually convert to gamma 2.2 before lift, and then back again afterwards. (Gain and gamma are, up to constants, commutative with the de-gamma operation.)"

  - identifier: lift_r
    title: Lift Red
    type: float
    minimum: 0.0

---
schema_version: 0.1
type: filter
identifier: lift_gamma_gain
title: Lift, Gamma, and Gain
version: 1
copyright: Meltytech, LLC
license: LGPLv2.1
language: en
tags:
  - Video
description: A simple lift/gamma/gain effect, used for color grading.
notes: "Very roughly speaking, lift=shadows, gamma=midtones and gain=highlights, although all parameters affect the entire curve. Mathematically speaking, it is a bit unusual to look at gamma as a color, but it works pretty well in practice. The classic formula is: output = (gain * (x + lift * (1-x)))^(1/gamma). The lift is a case where we actually would _not_ want linear light; since black by definition becomes equal to the lift color, we want lift to be pretty close to black, but in linear light that means lift affects the rest of the curve relatively little. Thus, we actually convert to gamma 2.2 before lift, and then back again afterwards. (Gain and gamma are, up to constants, commutative with the de-gamma operation.)"

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import os

def create_project():
    orig_path = "/home/ga/Documents/Justin Edit/Justin Edit.kdenlive"
    tree = ET.parse(orig_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    # 1. Update Sequence Tractor
    seq_uuid = "{9c890dd4-1d70-47ab-a5d3-a1af8f25453e}"
    seq = root.find(f"./tractor[@id='{seq_uuid}']")
    seq.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    seq.set("out", "00:01:26.867")

    def set_prop(elem, name, value):
        p = elem.find(f"./property[@name='{name}']")
        if p is None:
            p = ET.SubElement(elem, "property", {"name": name})
        p.text = str(value)

    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:clipname", "YouTube")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:duration", "00:01:26:26")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:maxduration", "2606")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.zonein", "0")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.zoneout", "2606")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.position", "0")

    # 2. Update Track Tractors
    t0 = root.find("./tractor[@id='tractor0']")
    t0.set("out", "00:01:26.867")
    set_prop(t0, "kdenlive:track_name", "Music")
    set_prop(t0, "kdenlive:role", "Music")
    set_prop(t0, "kdenlive:audio_track", "1")

    t1 = root.find("./tractor[@id='tractor1']")
    t1.set("out", "00:01:26.867")

---
schema_version: 0.3
type: filter
identifier: vidstab
title: Vid.Stab Detect and Transform
copyright: Jakub Ksiezniak
creator: Marco Gittler <g.marco@freenet.de>
version: 2
license: GPL
language: en
url: "http://public.hronopik.de/vid.stab/"
tags:
  - Video
description: Stabilize Video (for wiggly/rolling video)
notes: |
       This filter requires two passes. The first pass performs analysis and stores the result in a file. Upon successful completion of the analysis, the "results" property is updated with the name of the file storing the results. The second pass applies the results to the image.
       To use with melt, use 'melt ... -consumer xml:output.mlt all=1 real_time=-1' for the first pass. Parallel processing (real_time < -1 or > 1) is not supported for the first pass. For the second pass, use output.mlt as the input.
parameters:
  - identifier: results
    title: Analysis Results
    type: string
    description: Set after analysis. Used during application. A set of image motion information that describes the analyzed clip. When results are not supplied, the filter computes the results and stores them in a file. This property is updated with the name of that file when the last frame has been processed.
    mutable: no
  - identifier: filename
    title: Target File Name
    type: string
    description: Used during analysis. The name of the file to store the analysis results in.
    required: no
    readonly: no
    default: vidstab.trf
    widget: fileopen
  - identifier: shakiness
    title: Shakiness
    type: integer
    description: Used during analysis. How shaky the video is.
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: 1
    maximum: 10
    default: 4
    mutable: no
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: accuracy
    title: Accuracy
    type: integer
    description: Used during analysis. The accuracy of shakiness detection.
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: 1
    maximum: 15
    default: 4
    mutable: no
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: stepsize
    title: Stepsize
    type: integer
    description: Used during analysis. The step size of the search process.
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: 0
    maximum: 100
    default: 6
    mutable: no
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: mincontrast
    title: Minimum Contrast
    type: float
    description: Used during analysis. Below this contrast, a field is discarded.
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: 0
    maximum: 1
    default: 0.3
    mutable: no
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: show
    title: Show
    type: integer
    description: Used during analysis. 0 = draw nothing 1 or 2 = show fields and transforms
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: 0
    maximum: 2
    default: 0
    mutable: no
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: tripod
    title: Tripod
    type: integer
    description: Used during analysis and application. if 0, tripod mode is disabled. if > 0, specifies the frame to be used as a reference frame for tripod mode During application, relative and smoothing properties are both ignored if tripod mode is in use.
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: 0
    maximum: 100000
    default: 0
    mutable: no
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: smoothing
    title: Smoothing
    type: integer
    description: Used during application. Number of frames for lowpass filtering (2N + 1 frames)
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: 0
    maximum: 100
    default: 15
    mutable: yes
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: maxshift
    title: Maxshift
    type: integer
    description: Used during application. Maximum number of pixels to transform the image. -1 = no limit
    unit: pixels
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: -1
    maximum: 1000
    default: -1
    mutable: yes
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: maxangle
    title: Maxangle
    type: float
    description: Used during application. Maximum angle to rotate, -1 = no limit
    unit: radians
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: -1
    maximum: 3.142
    default: -1
    mutable: yes
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: crop
    title: Crop
    type: boolean
    description: Used during application. 0 = keep border, 1 = black background
    readonly: no
    required: no
    default: 0
    mutable: yes
  - identifier: invert
    title: Invert
    type: boolean
    description: Used during application. Invert transforms
    readonly: no
    required: no
    default: 0
    mutable: yes
  - identifier: relative
    title: Relative
    type: boolean
    description: Used during application. Consider transforms as absolute (0) or relative (1)
    readonly: no
    required: no
    default: 1
    mutable: yes
  - identifier: zoom
    title: Zoom
    type: integer
    description: Used during application. Additional zoom amount
    unit: percent
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: -500
    maximum: 500
    default: 0
    mutable: yes
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: optzoom
    title: Optimal Zoom
    type: integer
    description: Used during application. Automatically determine optimal zoom. 1 - static zoom, 2 - adaptive zoom
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: 0
    maximum: 2
    default: 1
    mutable: yes
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: zoomspeed
    title: Optimal Zoom Speed
    type: float
    description: Used during application. Zoom per frame (used when optzoom = 2)
    unit: percent
    readonly: no
    required: no
    minimum: 0
    maximum: 1
    default: 0.25
    mutable: yes
    widget: spinner
  - identifier: reload
    title: Reload Results
    description: The application should set this to 1 when it updates the results property to indicate that the results should be reloaded.
    type: boolean
    mutable: yes
  - identifier: analyze
    title: Commence analysis
    description: This is optional, but it can help applications avoid race conditions writing to the file. When not set, it does not affect the start of analysis. When set, analysis only starts and the file written if true.
    type: boolean
...

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import os

def create_project(out_path="/home/ga/Documents/Justin Edit/Justin Edit.kdenlive"):
    orig_path = "/home/ga/Documents/Justin Edit/Justin Edit.kdenlive"
    tree = ET.parse(orig_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    def set_prop(elem, name, value):
        p = elem.find(f"./property[@name='{name}']")
        if p is None:
            p = ET.SubElement(elem, "property", {"name": name})
        p.text = str(value)

    seq_uuid = "{9c890dd4-1d70-47ab-a5d3-a1af8f25453e}"
    seq = root.find(f"./tractor[@id='{seq_uuid}']")
    seq.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    seq.set("out", "00:01:26.867")

    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:clipname", "YouTube")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:duration", "00:01:26:26")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:maxduration", "2606")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.zonein", "0")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.zoneout", "2606")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.position", "0")

    # 1. Update Title Producer (producer1)
    p1 = root.find("./producer[@id='producer1']")
    p1.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    p1.set("out", "00:00:05.100")
    set_prop(p1, "length", "154")
    set_prop(p1, "kdenlive:duration", "00:00:05:04")
    set_prop(p1, "kdenlive:clipname", "JUSTIN BROWN")
    
    title_xml = (
        '<kdenlivetitle duration="154" LC_NUMERIC="C" width="1920" height="1080" out="153">\n'
        ' <item type="QGraphicsRectItem" z-index="0">\n'
        '  <position x="760" y="825">\n'
        '   <transform>1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1</transform>\n'
        '  </position>\n'
        '  <content rect="0,0,400,75" penwidth="0" pencolor="0,0,0,0" brushcolor="0,119,255,255"/>\n'
        ' </item>\n'
        ' <item type="QGraphicsTextItem" z-index="1">\n'
        '  <position x="794" y="815">\n'
        '   <transform>1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1</transform>\n'
        '  </position>\n'
        '  <content font="Oswald" font-weight="75" font-pixel-size="56" font-color="255,255,255,255">JUSTIN BROWN</content>\n'
        ' </item>\n'
        ' <startviewport rect="0,0,1920,1080"/>\n'
        ' <endviewport rect="0,0,1920,1080"/>\n'
        ' <background color="0,0,0,0"/>\n'
        '</kdenlivetitle>\n'
    )
    set_prop(p1, "xmldata", title_xml)

    # 2. Update Playlist 4 (Track V1 - Presenter Video)
    pl4 = root.find("./playlist[@id='playlist4']")
    del pl4[:]

    # V1 Clip 1: 00:00:00.000 to 00:00:12.633 (379 frames)
    e1 = ET.SubElement(pl4, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain4",
        "in": "00:00:31.667",
        "out": "00:00:44.267"
    })
    set_prop(e1, "kdenlive:id", "4")

    # V1 Clip 2: 00:00:12.633 to 00:00:16.300 (111 frames = 00:00:03:21)
    e2 = ET.SubElement(pl4, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain4",
        "in": "00:00:44.300",
        "out": "00:00:47.967"
    })
    set_prop(e2, "kdenlive:id", "4")

    # V1 Clip 3: 00:00:16.300 to 00:00:36.000 (590 frames)
    e3 = ET.SubElement(pl4, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain4",
        "in": "00:00:48.000",
        "out": "00:01:07.633"
    })
    set_prop(e3, "kdenlive:id", "4")

    # V1 Clip 4: 00:00:36.000 to 00:01:26.867 (1526 frames)
    e4 = ET.SubElement(pl4, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain4",
        "in": "00:01:07.667",
        "out": "00:01:58.500"
    })
    set_prop(e4, "kdenlive:id", "4")

    # 3. Update Tractor 2 (Track V1)
    t2 = root.find("./tractor[@id='tractor2']")
    t2.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    t2.set("out", "00:01:26.867")
    set_prop(t2, "kdenlive:track_name", "Video 1")

    # Remove old custom filters in t2 if any, keep track elements
    for f in list(t2.findall("filter")):
        t2.remove(f)

    # Color grade applied to Video 1 (warm, bright, contrast, vibrant saturation)
    f_eq = ET.SubElement(t2, "filter", {"id": "v1_color_eq"})
    set_prop(f_eq, "mlt_service", "avfilter.eq")
    set_prop(f_eq, "kdenlive_id", "avfilter.eq")
    set_prop(f_eq, "tag", "avfilter.eq")
    set_prop(f_eq, "av.brightness", "0.04")
    set_prop(f_eq, "av.contrast", "1.20")
    set_prop(f_eq, "av.saturation", "1.20")
    set_prop(f_eq, "disable", "0")

    f_temp = ET.SubElement(t2, "filter", {"id": "v1_color_temp"})
    set_prop(f_temp, "mlt_service", "avfilter.colortemperature")
    set_prop(f_temp, "kdenlive_id", "avfilter.colortemperature")
    set_prop(f_temp, "tag", "avfilter.colortemperature")
    set_prop(f_temp, "av.temperature", "5800")
    set_prop(f_temp, "disable", "0")

    # Segment 2 punch-in (00:00:12.633 to 00:00:16.300)
    f_punch = ET.SubElement(t2, "filter", {
        "id": "v1_c2_punch",
        "in": "00:00:12.633",
        "out": "00:00:16.300"
    })
    set_prop(f_punch, "mlt_service", "qtblend")
    set_prop(f_punch, "kdenlive_id", "qtblend")
    set_prop(f_punch, "tag", "qtblend")
    set_prop(f_punch, "rect", "-163 -92 2246 1264 1")
    set_prop(f_punch, "compositing", "0")
    set_prop(f_punch, "distort", "0")
    set_prop(f_punch, "rotate_center", "1")
    set_prop(f_punch, "disable", "0")

    # Segment 2 gaussian blur (00:00:12.633 to 00:00:16.300)
    f_blur = ET.SubElement(t2, "filter", {
        "id": "v1_c2_blur",
        "in": "00:00:12.633",
        "out": "00:00:16.300"
    })
    set_prop(f_blur, "mlt_service", "avfilter.gblur")
    set_prop(f_blur, "kdenlive_id", "avfilter.gblur")
    set_prop(f_blur, "tag", "avfilter.gblur")
    set_prop(f_blur, "av.sigma", "2.5")
    set_prop(f_blur, "disable", "0")

    # 4. Update Playlist 2 (Track A1 - Dialogue)
    pl2 = root.find("./playlist[@id='playlist2']")
    del pl2[:]
    set_prop(pl2, "kdenlive:audio_track", "1")

    # Contiguous audio segments aligned with V1 picture
    for pin, pout in [
        ("00:00:31.667", "00:00:44.267"),
        ("00:00:44.300", "00:00:47.967"),
        ("00:00:48.000", "00:01:07.633"),
        ("00:01:07.667", "00:01:58.500")
    ]:
        d = ET.SubElement(pl2, "entry", {
            "producer": "chain4",
            "in": pin,
            "out": pout
        })
        set_prop(d, "kdenlive:id", "4")
        set_prop(d, "kdenlive:role", "Dialogue")

    # 5. Update Tractor 1 (Track A1 - Dialogue)
    t1 = root.find("./tractor[@id='tractor1']")
    t1.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    t1.set("out", "00:01:26.867")

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def build_project(output_path="/home/ga/Documents/Justin Edit/Justin Edit.kdenlive"):
    orig_path = "/home/ga/Documents/Justin Edit/Justin Edit.kdenlive"
    tree = ET.parse(orig_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    def set_prop(elem, name, value):
        p = elem.find(f"./property[@name='{name}']")
        if p is None:
            p = ET.SubElement(elem, "property", {"name": name})
        p.text = str(value)

    # 1. Update Sequence Tractor
    seq_uuid = "{9c890dd4-1d70-47ab-a5d3-a1af8f25453e}"
    seq = root.find(f"./tractor[@id='{seq_uuid}']")
    seq.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    seq.set("out", "00:01:26.867")

    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:clipname", "YouTube")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:duration", "00:01:26:26")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:maxduration", "2606")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.zonein", "0")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.zoneout", "2606")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.position", "0")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.scrollPos", "0")

    # 2. Update Title Producer (producer1)
    p1 = root.find("./producer[@id='producer1']")
    p1.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    p1.set("out", "00:00:05.100")
    set_prop(p1, "length", "154")
    set_prop(p1, "kdenlive:duration", "00:00:05:04")
    set_prop(p1, "kdenlive:clipname", "JUSTIN BROWN")

    title_xml = (
        '<kdenlivetitle duration="154" LC_NUMERIC="C" width="1920" height="1080" out="153">\n'
        ' <item type="QGraphicsRectItem" z-index="0">\n'
        '  <position x="760" y="825">\n'
        '   <transform>1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1</transform>\n'
        '  </position>\n'
        '  <content rect="0,0,400,75" penwidth="0" pencolor="0,0,0,0" brushcolor="0,119,255,255"/>\n'
        ' </item>\n'
        ' <item type="QGraphicsTextItem" z-index="1">\n'
        '  <position x="794" y="815">\n'
        '   <transform>1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0,1</transform>\n'
        '  </position>\n'
        '  <content font="Oswald" font-weight="75" font-pixel-size="56" font-color="255,255,255,255">JUSTIN BROWN</content>\n'
        ' </item>\n'
        ' <startviewport rect="0,0,1920,1080"/>\n'
        ' <endviewport rect="0,0,1920,1080"/>\n'
        ' <background color="0,0,0,0"/>\n'
        '</kdenlivetitle>\n'
    )
    set_prop(p1, "xmldata", title_xml)

    # 3. Playlist 4 (Track V1 - Presenter Video)
    pl4 = root.find("./playlist[@id='playlist4']")
    del pl4[:]

    # Cut 1: 00:00:00.000 to 00:00:12.633 (379 frames)
    e1 = ET.SubElement(pl4, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain7",
        "in": "00:00:31.667",
        "out": "00:00:44.267"
    })
    set_prop(e1, "kdenlive:id", "4")

    # Cut 2: 00:00:12.633 to 00:00:16.300 (111 frames = 00:00:03:21)
    e2 = ET.SubElement(pl4, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain7",
        "in": "00:00:44.300",
        "out": "00:00:47.967"
    })
    set_prop(e2, "kdenlive:id", "4")

    # Cut 3: 00:00:16.300 to 00:00:36.000 (590 frames)
    e3 = ET.SubElement(pl4, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain7",
        "in": "00:00:48.000",
        "out": "00:01:07.633"
    })
    set_prop(e3, "kdenlive:id", "4")

    # Cut 4: 00:00:36.000 to 00:01:26.867 (1526 frames)
    e4 = ET.SubElement(pl4, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain7",
        "in": "00:01:07.667",
        "out": "00:01:58.500"
    })
    set_prop(e4, "kdenlive:id", "4")

    # 4. Tractor 2 (Track V1)
    t2 = root.find("./tractor[@id='tractor2']")
    t2.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    t2.set("out", "00:01:26.867")
    set_prop(t2, "kdenlive:track_name", "Video 1")

    for f in list(t2.findall("filter")):
        t2.remove(f)

    # Color grading on Video 1
    f_eq = ET.SubElement(t2, "filter", {"id": "v1_color_eq"})
    set_prop(f_eq, "mlt_service", "avfilter.eq")
    set_prop(f_eq, "kdenlive_id", "avfilter.eq")
    set_prop(f_eq, "tag", "avfilter.eq")
    set_prop(f_eq, "av.brightness", "0.04")
    set_prop(f_eq, "av.contrast", "1.20")
    set_prop(f_eq, "av.saturation", "1.20")
    set_prop(f_eq, "disable", "0")

    f_temp = ET.SubElement(t2, "filter", {"id": "v1_color_temp"})
    set_prop(f_temp, "mlt_service", "avfilter.colortemperature")
    set_prop(f_temp, "kdenlive_id", "avfilter.colortemperature")
    set_prop(f_temp, "tag", "avfilter.colortemperature")
    set_prop(f_temp, "av.temperature", "5800")
    set_prop(f_temp, "disable", "0")

    # Punch-in on cut 2 (scale 117%)
    f_punch = ET.SubElement(t2, "filter", {
        "id": "v1_c2_punch",
        "in": "00:00:12.633",
        "out": "00:00:16.300"
    })
    set_prop(f_punch, "mlt_service", "qtblend")
    set_prop(f_punch, "kdenlive_id", "qtblend")
    set_prop(f_punch, "tag", "qtblend")
    set_prop(f_punch, "rect", "-163 -92 2246 1264 1")
    set_prop(f_punch, "compositing", "0")
    set_prop(f_punch, "distort", "0")
    set_prop(f_punch, "rotate_center", "1")
    set_prop(f_punch, "disable", "0")

    # Gaussian blur on cut 2
    f_blur = ET.SubElement(t2, "filter", {
        "id": "v1_c2_blur",
        "in": "00:00:12.633",
        "out": "00:00:16.300"
    })
    set_prop(f_blur, "mlt_service", "avfilter.gblur")
    set_prop(f_blur, "kdenlive_id", "avfilter.gblur")
    set_prop(f_blur, "tag", "avfilter.gblur")
    set_prop(f_blur, "av.sigma", "2.5")
    set_prop(f_blur, "disable", "0")

    # 5. Playlist 2 (Track A1 - Dialogue)
    pl2 = root.find("./playlist[@id='playlist2']")
    del pl2[:]
    set_prop(pl2, "kdenlive:audio_track", "1")

    for pin, pout in [
        ("00:00:31.667", "00:00:44.267"),
        ("00:00:44.300", "00:00:47.967"),
        ("00:00:48.000", "00:01:07.633"),
        ("00:01:07.667", "00:01:58.500")
    ]:
        d = ET.SubElement(pl2, "entry", {
            "producer": "chain0",
            "in": pin,
            "out": pout
        })
        set_prop(d, "kdenlive:id", "4")
        set_prop(d, "kdenlive:role", "Dialogue")

    # 6. Tractor 1 (Track A1 - Dialogue)
    t1 = root.find("./tractor[@id='tractor1']")
    t1.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    t1.set("out", "00:01:26.867")
    set_prop(t1, "kdenlive:track_name", "Dialogue")
    set_prop(t1, "kdenlive:role", "Dialogue")
    set_prop(t1, "kdenlive:audio_track", "1")

    # 7. Playlist 0 (Track A2 - Music)
    pl0 = root.find("./playlist[@id='playlist0']")
    del pl0[:]
    set_prop(pl0, "kdenlive:audio_track", "1")

    m1 = ET.SubElement(pl0, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain6",
        "in": "00:00:00.000",
        "out": "00:01:26.867"
    })
    set_prop(m1, "kdenlive:id", "9")
    set_prop(m1, "kdenlive:role", "Music")

    # 8. Tractor 0 (Track A2 - Music)
    t0 = root.find("./tractor[@id='tractor0']")
    t0.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    t0.set("out", "00:01:26.867")
    set_prop(t0, "kdenlive:track_name", "Music")
    set_prop(t0, "kdenlive:role", "Music")
    set_prop(t0, "kdenlive:audio_track", "1")

    # Music volume: -31.48 dB, unmuted
    f0 = t0.find("./filter[@id='filter0']")
    if f0 is not None:
        set_prop(f0, "level", "-31.48")
        set_prop(f0, "gain", "-31.48dB")
        set_prop(f0, "disable", "0")
    else:
        f_mvol = ET.SubElement(t0, "filter", {"id": "music_volume"})
        set_prop(f_mvol, "mlt_service", "volume")
        set_prop(f_mvol, "kdenlive_id", "volume")
        set_prop(f_mvol, "tag", "volume")
        set_prop(f_mvol, "level", "-31.48")
        set_prop(f_mvol, "gain", "-31.48dB")
        set_prop(f_mvol, "disable", "0")

    # 9. Playlist 6 (Track V2 - Overlays)
    pl6 = root.find("./playlist[@id='playlist6']")
    del pl6[:]

    # 0 to 16: blank
    ET.SubElement(pl6, "blank", {"length": "00:00:00.533"})

    # Title: frame 16 to 169 (153 frames = 5.1s)
    etitle = ET.SubElement(pl6, "entry", {
        "producer": "producer1",
        "in": "00:00:00.000",
        "out": "00:00:05.100"
    })
    set_prop(etitle, "kdenlive:id", "10")

    # Blank to frame 450 (15.000s)
    ET.SubElement(pl6, "blank", {"length": "00:00:09.367"})

    # Waterfall clip (chain1): frame 450 to 601 (151 frames = 00:00:05:01)
    ewater = ET.SubElement(pl6, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain1",
        "in": "00:00:29.300",
        "out": "00:00:34.333"
    })
    set_prop(ewater, "kdenlive:id", "5")

    # Blank to frame 1080 (36.000s)
    ET.SubElement(pl6, "blank", {"length": "00:00:15.967"})

    # Ocean clip (chain2): frame 1080 to 1697 (617 frames = 00:00:20:17)
    e_ocean = ET.SubElement(pl6, "entry", {
        "producer": "chain2",
        "in": "00:00:02.300",
        "out": "00:00:22.867"
    })
    set_prop(e_ocean, "kdenlive:id", "6")

    # Blank to sequence end
    ET.SubElement(pl6, "blank", {"length": "00:00:30.300"})

    # 10. Tractor 3 (Track V2)
    t3 = root.find("./tractor[@id='tractor3']")
    t3.set("in", "00:00:00.000")

    orig_path = "/home/ga/Documents/Justin Edit/Justin Edit.kdenlive"
    tree = ET.parse(orig_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    def set_prop(elem, name, value):
        p = elem.find(f"./property[@name='{name}']")
        if p is None:
            p = ET.SubElement(elem, "property", {"name": name})
        p.text = str(value)

    # 1. Update Sequence Tractor
    seq_uuid = "{9c890dd4-1d70-47ab-a5d3-a1af8f25453e}"
    seq = root.find(f"./tractor[@id='{seq_uuid}']")
    seq.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    seq.set("out", "00:01:26.867")

    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:clipname", "YouTube")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:duration", "00:01:26:26")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:maxduration", "2606")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.zonein", "0")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.zoneout", "2606")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.position", "0")
    set_prop(seq, "kdenlive:sequenceproperties.scrollPos", "0")

    # 2. Update Title Producer (producer1)
    p1 = root.find("./producer[@id='producer1']")
    p1.set("in", "00:00:00.000")
    p1.set("out", "00:00:05.100")
    set_prop(p1, "length", "154")
    set_prop(p1, "kdenlive:duration", "00:00:05:04")
    set_prop(p1, "kdenlive:clipname", "JUSTIN BROWN")

    title_xml = (
        '<kdenlivetitle duration="154" LC_NUMERIC="C" width="1920" height="1080" out="153">\n'
